description: Independent 1 V probe sources through 1-ohm resistors feed nhi and nlo; the pair drives a 10-ohm load with ron=1. Break-before-make is asserted on CONDUCTANCE: if both switches ever conducted, each probe would carry ~45 mA simultaneously; with BBM the smaller of the two currents never exceeds leakage. A plateau check also pins the closed-switch endpoint resistance at ron. body_diodes=0 so diode paths cannot mask switch conduction.
dut: X1 ctl 0 nhi sw nlo bhv_sw_bbm_pair_v1 tdead=20n tedge=2n ron=1 roff=1e6 body_diodes=0

relations.derivation: single-on probe current is 1V/(1+ron+10)=83.3 mA; simultaneous conduction would put ~45 mA through BOTH probes. The 8 mA bound is <10% of single-on and >1000x leakage (~1 uA at roff=1e6).
closed high-side switch at exactly ron=1: i(vp1) = -1V/(1+1+10) = -83.33 mA; verifies the aswitch rails are not extrapolated beyond ron.
